conclusions: The known 1.0.0, 1.1.0, 1.2.0, 1.2.1, 1.3.0, 2.0.0, and 2.0.1 coordinates are permanently consumed by unrelated historical publication and must never be reused.
A 0.1.x version does not satisfy ordinary former 1.x or 2.x semantic-version ranges.
The new package has no code, API, ownership, or provenance relationship with the unpublished Overwatch package.
Read-only registry and installation probes cannot prove publishing authority; the complete qualified real publication attempt remains decisive.
The bounded evidence does not claim that no private consumer or unusually broad historical range exists.
